keyFindings.description: Round-2 #5 not fixed: refreshStalePlugins skips a no-install (Claude Code) claim only once a round is recorded; the boot pass and first sweep run before any round opens, and staleRegistration charges relaunchAfterFailure until failed. Reproduced by two subagents.

Round-2 #2 partly fixed: answeringRound guards only a confirmed ask in a working turn; late agent_start (noTurn), daemon restart (askFirst) and foreign turns still bind an answer to a round whose words the worker never read. Reproduced (prompts=1 podWordsSent=false).

Round-2 #1 residual: liveGroup re-reads only snapshot members (a claim created after the snapshot is cut, reproduced), nothing re-checks after ReplacePod starts waiting on lockPod (reproduced), and Claim() blocks the sweep behind relaunch decisions.
New: tellPodlessRound escalates a round whose every claim answered and was then daemon-suspended; the controller's answered row then opens a false finding ask for a person. Reproduced.

New: the answer's wait arms no reminder; when a round ends without a replacement (drift reverts), a mid-phase worker sits idle with its phase open and nothing wakes it. Docs (phase-stall.ts, claude-envoy AGENTS.md, both fragments) still say a reminder comes back.
openPodUpdate gets the snapshot group while completePodUpdate read live; a late notice can carry empty waiting, which the store refuses every tick. Reproduced.
turnEnded returns refreshPlugin's result in place of sendPending; when the held relaunch is a no-op the queued task is not sent.
podProcess(live) can pick a claim already relaunched into a fresh pod and replace that undrifted pod.
A held suspension skips the turn-end hold, so endHeld cuts the turn though the suspension would end it at turn end anyway.
An answered plugin round kept by a lasting launch refusal never sends a late notice; liveGroup can count a claim retired mid-tick as waiting.

Code quality in touched files: 'answered this round' spelled three times; two parsers of the ask-id format; throwaway Claim struct in UpdateTask; awaitingUpdate mode flag outside the stall machine; keptPod.store half-filled ompsessions.Store.
